comment: Triage evaluation was extremely precise. The action items are perfect and reflect standard pediatric emergency procedures.
Clinical recommendation is accurate, but the Step 3 symptom questionnaire has some cluttered spacing on smaller mobile layouts. The labels should be more compact.
Follow-up advice was perfect for this localized skin rash. Family doctor follow-up prevents unnecessary ER crowding.
Over-triaged a minor croup bark to High Emergency. If there is no stridor at rest, we should route to Urgent Care rather than forcing an ER visit.
Workflow to access triage is too slow. Clinicians and parents would prefer entering symptoms first and registering demographic details afterwards.
Primary care recommendation was accurate. Good reassurance logic for dry skin patches.
Would be extremely helpful if the system automatically calculated child fever reducer dosage (acetaminophen/ibuprofen) based on the child's weight in kilograms.
Excellent routing. Chest indrawing is a clear red flag requiring pediatric ER.
The exit assessment button at the top does not warn the user that they will lose their state. It should pop up a confirmation warning before returning to the landing page.
Accurate triage. Minor fever with runny nose was appropriately categorized as Moderate Urgent Care.
